plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any given bid from others, bidding your value maximizes your expected profit. If I bid less than my value, I risk losing the auction to someone who bids higher, even if their value is lower than mine. If I bid more than my value, I risk overpaying. Since this is round 1 of 1, there's no history to learn from. Therefore, I will bid my value.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win only if the prize is worth at least as much as what you pay for it. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction even when the prize is worth more than the second-highest bid. Bidding more than your value risks winning the auction and paying more than the prize is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $8.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you maximize your expected profit regardless of what the other bidders do. If I bid less than my value, I risk losing the auction to someone who bids higher but values the item less. If I bid more, I risk overpaying. Therefore, I will bid $44.
